key.afk-chat-alert.toggle: Turn AFK Chat Alert on or off
message.afk-chat-alert.enabled: AFK Chat Alert is now turn'd on
message.afk-chat-alert.disabled: AFK Chat Alert is now turn'd off
config.afk-chat-alert.title: Settings for AFK Chat Alert
config.afk-chat-alert.option.focusLossAf: Reckon the game window AFK so soon as it loseth focus (alt-tab / minish it). Windows 10/11 only — on all other platforms it sleepeth in silence.
config.afk-chat-alert.clothRequired: The settings screen within the game hath need of Cloth Config (not needful). Thou mayst instead fashion AFK Chat Alert by editing config/afk-chat-alert.json.
